text: Done: I made the engine pickier on both bids and bets, effective now. Bid slider 88 to 60, 'many small bids' off, and the 'keep the wallet fully deployed' setting off (that one was pushing extra riskier bids in just to use money). Bet slider 61 to 50. Expect fewer fills, which is the point. The engine is paused at $0.01 anyway, so this applies once money is back in. I'll watch the next digests for fill count and CLV, and loosen if quality isn't better.
